Overview.Description: Scan and extract ESG metric values from a company ESG/Sustainability report and complete a structured Excel file.

OutputColumns.Column: Supporting sentence, bullet or table row
One tag from the tagging guide

Instructions.Step: Start by scanning summary/KPI tables, usually near the end of the report.

Perform a complete and exhaustive pass through the full report in this order: Executive summary ESG strategy or performance sections Framework disclosures (e.g., GRI, SASB, TCFD, CDP) Appendices, footnotes, glossary
Extract metrics systematically and individually. Keep track of what's found or missing.
If multiple values are present, prefer: Most recent reporting year Summary/KPI tables over narrative Values with explicit units and clear attribution
Output the final Excel file after reviewing all 44 metrics.

RemarksTaggingGuide.Tag: Value is explicitly stated (e.g., "Scope 1 emissions: 30,000 tons CO₂e")
Deduced from clear context (e.g., calculated from subtotals)
Approximate from vague data (e.g., estimated from a bar chart)
Based on logical assumption due to missing details
Metric could not be found or inferred in time
